scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: State Capital Investment Subsidy
other_conditions: Enterprises must have started production between 01.01.2022 and 31.12.2024
Enterprises should have executed a four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja
Units may be private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, companies/undertakings owned and managed by the State Government, or Industrial SHGs
The project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution or Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
benefits_summary: Provides a 20% subsidy on the fixed capital investment for plant and machinery (new age shuttleless powerloom).
